stdout:
Usage: main harnesses list [OPTIONS]

  List all registered harness adapters.

Options:
  -q, --quiet            Suppress informational output; only errors are emitted.
  -v, --verbose          Emit additional diagnostic output.
  --format [plain|json]  Output format.  [default: plain]
  --no-color             Disable ANSI color codes in output.
  --json                 Shorthand for --format json.
  -h, --help             Show this message and exit.

  Examples:   apothem harnesses list   apothem harnesses list --json

  Related commands:   harnesses show  Show details for a specific harness
  doctor          Run system diagnostics

  Exit codes:   0  Success   1  Every adapter failed to load or report   2  At
  least one adapter listed, at least one failed
